tagline.en: Food Science PhD candidate | Flavor Chemistry × Machine Learning
tagline.zh: 食品科学博士研究生 | 风味化学 × 机器学习

bio.en: I'm a Food Science PhD candidate at Jiangnan University, with joint PhD training at the National University of Singapore, graduating in June 2027. I work on flavor chemistry and machine learning: GC-MS and GC-O analysis, sensory evaluation, and models that link molecules to perception. In the lab I built a GC-MS processing system that has handled more than 3,000 samples; the tools below are browser versions of that kind of work.
bio.zh: 江南大学食品科学与工程博士在读，在新加坡国立大学进行联合培养，2027 年 6 月毕业。研究方向是风味化学与机器学习：GC-MS / GC-O 分析、感官评价，以及把分子和感知联系起来的模型。在实验室里我开发过一套 GC-MS 数据处理系统，累计处理样品 3000 多个；下面这些工具是同类工作的浏览器版本。
